engineering_dimension_contract.high_gate_implication: u>>1 implies X^(1/4)>>Lambda_g. Therefore the high-gate branch is outside a naive small-u derivative expansion around u=0.
engineering_dimension_contract.interpretation_boundary: Large first derivatives do not by themselves prove EFT failure. Kinetic screening can require classical resummation; validity then needs a symmetry/protection argument, controlled higher-derivative expansion, and a background-dependent fluctuation analysis.

general_gate_boundary.integer_p: Positive integer p gives a finite polynomial in u, but loops can still generate other symmetry-allowed operators unless protected.
general_gate_boundary.noninteger_p: The binomial expansion about u=0 has radius |u|<1 and cannot define the high-u branch by termwise truncation; the full nonpolynomial function must be treated as fundamental/resummed within its EFT domain.
general_gate_boundary.regular_variation: The range/source theorem can remain mathematically correct as an asymptotic statement even if a particular EFT realization lacks controlled access to that asymptotic domain.

p2_operator_contract.important_distinction: For m_chi<Lambda_g the vacuum scattering interaction scales can exceed Lambda_g even though the background gate becomes nonlinear at X^(1/4)~Lambda_g. Background resummation and perturbative scattering cutoff are not the same statement.
